title: Experiences
description: Manage the organization catalog, shared default and permitted personal options.
label: Name
providerHint: Only registered providers are offered. Missing saved references remain visible; importing a preset never installs or enables code.
sectionsHint: Use source identities published by the contributing modules. Fields and business rules keep their existing owners.
draftOnly: This edits a draft. Server validation and a review of organization-wide changes are required before saving.
sharedWarning: These settings affect the whole organization. The default is shared; personal choices remain subject to the permitted profiles and policy. No personal values are deleted.
withdrawWarning: Withdrawing this profile can make saved personal selections fall back to the organization default or application baseline. Stored references are retained.
previewHint: This is a structural preview, not a live record. Component registration does not certify a complete journey. Sections still need record-specific eligibility, visibility and permission checks. Missing or incompatible providers use the existing fallback.
unavailable: Unavailable, ambiguous or incompatible; fallback or omission applies
contextRequired: Requires verification in an authorized record context
codeWarning: Preset configuration does not admit executable code. Integrated frontend code must be reviewed separately by an installation administrator in Modules, with application-level trust.
fileTooLarge: Choose a JSON file up to 512 KiB.
invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
stale: The organization changed since this draft was opened. Reload and review the current configuration before applying.
conflict: The organization changed. Your draft was not saved. Reload current values and review the changes again.
importHint: Import replaces the entire draft catalog, default and policy after server validation. Compare the differences before applying; it does not install code or overwrite personal preferences.
empty: No profiles configured. The application baseline remains available.
defaultHint: Only enabled and permitted profiles can be the default. Changing it affects users without a valid permitted personal selection.
allowNavigation: Allow personal navigation and home adjustments
hideHint: Permit omission of these section sources only when their owner also declares them personally optional. This list cannot make required content optional or grant data access.
apply: Apply these changes to the organization
ownerHint: Views, dashboard widgets, themes and field layouts remain configured in their own settings. This page does not edit them.
reloadHint: Discard this local draft and load the current saved catalog? Unsaved changes will be lost.
validated: Draft validated. Review the changes and availability limits before applying.
offline: Configuration cannot be loaded while offline. Reconnect and retry.
